The '''field kitchen''' was a type of equipment manufactured by [[SurvivalEquipment Inc.]]<ref name="EtU" />

==Description==
The field kitchen was packed in an impact-resistant case and contained tools needed to feed a small number of sentient beings for a long amount of time. It contained pots, pans, [[Knife/Legends|knives]], cooking utensils, a [[water purifier]], a food sterilizer, and flash and vacuum sealing systems for food. A [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] was inside that contained a nutritional database for many sentient species.<ref name="EtU" />
